issue_context.title: Remove or limit table of content at the main Airflow doc page
issue_context.body:
Table of content here : http://apache-airflow-docs.s3-website.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/docs/apache-airflow/latest/index.html at the main page of "apache-airflow" documentation is huge and useless (especially that we have it in directory on the left). 


We should remove it or limit heavily (to 1st level only)


![Screenshot from 2020-11-22 20-34-28](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/595491/99915147-27738a00-2d02-11eb-8e6b-1e2717180f26.png)
comments:
It seems to me that it cannot be removed completely, but it will probably be possible to limit the levels of the depth quite simply.

I don't have plans to do it any time soon. I will add the label "good-first-issues" label.Maybe another person will be willing to take care of it.
@mik-laj You reverted this change so it's a problem again.

> We should remove it or **limit heavily (to 1st level only)**

In my opinion, this ticket is already resolved.

http://apache-airflow-docs.s3-website.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/docs/apache-airflow/latest/index.html

What else should we do here?

review_comments:
Whoops this shouldn't have been in this PR.

Bad Ash, no 🍪
